title: 第13章 珍蛊血眼蛊第14章 终于爆发
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
“被师尊从第九宫放逐到十二洞后，你非但没有收敛，反而变本加厉了。”
“变成了人不人，蛊不蛊，男不男，女不女的怪样。”
皇甫南低声喃喃。
他总觉得‘疯子’快成功了。
这是对方的机会，也是他的机会。
“如果能将他的本命蛊吞噬，我就有望踏足六转蛊师境，或许这是我最后的机会了！”
……
事了无痕。
李元假装无事发生。
十天后。
老王回来了，小昭也回来了。
和十天前分别时不同的是，小昭的双目上缠上了一块黑色的，厚厚的麻布。
“小昭这是？”
李元问道。
“也不知是好是坏。”
王邻叹息，“小昭在参加蛊师考验时，瞎了双眼，血虫却意外和她的眼球融合，进化成了珍蛊。”
“是血眼蛊？”
李元诧异。
天下异蛊只有三十三只，大多异蛊的培育方法都已失传。
在这种情况下，能拥有一只珍蛊作为本命蛊是件幸事，但也有例外。

血眼蛊便是例外之一。
“是啊。”
王邻长叹，“炼化血眼蛊必须以双目失明为代价，借此获得超乎寻常的感知能力。”
“以及用自身鲜血短暂复刻他人功法秘术的能力。”
“若小昭是个老江湖倒无妨，奈何她涉世未深，尚不适应，很容易在没掌握血眼蛊的能力前，就遭遇不测。”
这是王邻最担心的地方。
李元皱眉，“小昭获得珍蛊的事，已经上报给宗门了？”
“嗯。”
王邻点头，“这也没办法，只希望有些人不要太贪心。”
相比外界，这里是一片净土。
但净土也不会风平浪静，偶尔也会掀起波澜。
自从经历过执法堂事件和前些日子神秘黑衣人潜入残蛊楼的事件后，李元就意识到了。
正如老王所说，有人的地方就会有斗争。
“爷爷，我没事的。”
王昭昭的脸本来就小，被黑厚的麻布一遮，盖住了小半，她嘴角泛着苦笑，安慰老王。
“现在我也是蛊师了。”
content_en:
"After being banished from the Ninth Palace to the Twelve Cave by Master, instead of restraining yourself, you intensified your behavior."
"It has become a strange thing like a human being is not a human being, a voodoo is not a voodoo, a man is not a man, a woman is not a woman."
Huangfunan murmured softly.
He always felt that the 'madman' was about to succeed.
This is the opponent's opportunity and his opportunity.
"If I can devour his life Gu, I can hope to reach the rank six Gu Master realm. Maybe this is my last chance!"
…
It's all over without a trace.
Li Yuan pretended that nothing happened.
Ten days later.
Lao Wang is back, and so is Xiao Zhao.
The difference from when we parted ten days ago was that Xiao Zhao's eyes were wrapped with a piece of black, thick linen cloth.
"Xiao Zhao, what is this?"
Li Yuan asked.
"I don't know if it's good or bad."
Wang Lin sighed, "Xiao Zhao was blinded when she participated in the Gu Master test, but the blood worm accidentally fused with her eyeballs and evolved into a precious Gu."
"Is it blood eye Gu?"
Li Yuan was surprised.
There are only thirty-three exotic Gus in the world, and most of the methods for cultivating them have been lost.
In this case, it is a blessing to have a precious Gu as a natal Gu, but there are exceptions.
Blood Eye Gu is one of the exceptions.
"Yeah."
Wang Lin sighed, "Refining the Blood Eye Gu must be done at the cost of blindness in order to gain extraordinary perception."
"And the ability to use one's own blood to temporarily recreate other people's skills and secrets."
"It would be okay if Xiao Zhao is a veteran, but she is not yet experienced in the world and is not used to it. It is easy for her to encounter unexpected events before she has mastered the ability of the blood eye Gu."
This is what Wang Lin is most worried about.
Li Yuan frowned, "Has Xiao Zhao obtained the precious Gu been reported to the sect?"
"Yeah."
Wang Lin nodded, "There's nothing we can do about it. I just hope some people won't be too greedy."
Compared to the outside world, this place is a pure land.
But the Pure Land will not be calm, and occasionally it will cause waves.
Li Yuan has realized this since he experienced the Law Enforcement Hall incident and the mysterious man in black sneaking into the Can Gu Tower a few days ago.
As Lao Wang said, where there are people, there will be struggles.
"Grandpa, I'm fine."
Wang Zhaozhao's face was originally small, but half of it was covered by a thick black linen cloth. She comforted Lao Wang with a wry smile on her lips.
"I am also a Gu Master now."
